title: billing.plan.created payload
description: The `data` payload of the `billing.plan.created` event: a plan is published and becomes billable. The payload is the plan's whole current state rather than the fields that were just written — one representation, so an event and an HTTP response cannot disagree about what a plan costs. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

id.description: billing's plan row. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`. A uuid: `pln_[0-9A-Z]{26}` is the id core v0.2's first billing schema imagined, and no publisher has ever emitted it — see D10.

name.description: Display name, e.g. `Pro monthly`. Not stable: renaming a plan changes it, and nothing should key on it.

slug.description: Kebab-case, unique, and always one URL segment with nothing to escape — which is why the pattern is here rather than a length.

price.description: What one unit costs on this plan. Integer minor units and a currency, never a float: an amount that cannot represent 0.10 must never carry one.

amount_minor.description: Price per unit per interval, in the currency's minor units. Never negative — the publisher's column has a CHECK constraint for it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase. Shape-checked rather than checked against a list of live codes: a hand-maintained list of 180 currencies is a liability in a payment system, and a well-formed unfamiliar code should not be refused before the catalogue lands.

interval.description: The billing cadence. A closed set, and one the publisher's database constrains as well as the model.

trial_days.description: Trial length attached to the plan. Zero means none.

active.description: Whether the plan can be bought. A plan that is not active is not gone — `billing.plan.updated` is what says which of the two happened.

processor_product_id.description: The processor's product id, or null before the plan is registered there.

processor_price_id.description: The processor's price id, or null. This is the value a subscription payload calls `price_id`, under the name the processor uses for it.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when the plan row was written.

updated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC when the plan row last changed.
